source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of guarding against pharming (PDF 182).

blocks.text: Pharming tab hoti hai jab attackers aap ko asli (legitimate) website se hata kar jaali website par bhej dete hain ta ke aap ki maloomat chura sakein.

Misal: Agar aap apne bank ki website ka URL (web address) type karein, to pharming aap ko aisi jaali website par bhej sakti hai jo bilkul aap ke bank ki site jaisi lagti hai. Pharming se bachne ke liye hamesha check karein ke website ka address sahi aur secure (mehfooz) hai: address bar mein “https://” aur padlock (taale) ka nishan dekhein.

blocks.title: Tidbits (kaam ki baat)
blocks.text: Achhi online security ke liye kai tareeqe saath istemal karne chahiyein, jaise spam filters, antivirus software aur cookies ko soch samajh kar sambhalna, ta ke har qism ke khatre se bachao ho. Alag alag security tareeqe mila kar istemal karne se online khatron se behtar hifazat milti hai.

blocks.prompt: Padlock nazar aa raha hai, lekin address aap ke bank ke asli address ke bajaye “my-bank-login.example.com” hai. Kya yeh site mehfooz hai?
blocks.explanation: Nahi. Padlock sirf yeh batata hai ke connection encrypted (code mein badla hua, jise beech mein koi parh na sake) hai; is ke saath address bhi bilkul aap ke bank ka asli address hona chahiye. Isi liye kitab kehti hai ke address sahi bhi ho aur secure bhi.

items: Pharming se bachao: address sahi ho, “https://” aur padlock ho.
Kai security tareeqe saath istemal karein (Tidbits).
